description: This script is a Perl source file that provides command-line utility functions to manipulate Makefile-like scripts, such as adding hashes, fixing hashes, and renaming variables within makefiles. It processes a file based on specified commands and modifies its content accordingly.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: set_var
methods.description: Initializes and sets the variable state based on input variable string, parsing template and variable names.

methods.name: check_context
methods.description: Determines if the current line is within a makefile define/endef block to control modifications.
